name: Jōsō (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Jōsō city emblem in blue and green: a blue swirl like a letter G with three green strokes rising to the fly.
history: Municipal flag of Jōsō, a city in Ibaraki Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 January 2006.

features.role: Jōsō city emblem — a blue swirl like a letter G with three green strokes rising to the fly
